summary: The exact candidate fixes Qwen3-VL deep-stack linear_fc dimensions/indexing and the inherited MOSS dimension and regex-boundary counterexamples, but MOSS-VL merger linear_fc modules remain silently unregistered because their unindexed visual.merger paths have no layer ID.

tests.what_was_measured: At recorded base 358c163, both Qwen3-VL and MOSS-VL linear_fc dimension requests failed before returning shapes, and Qwen deepstack merger paths had no layer ID. Raw output: reports/j-dd5fea64a4ad/raw/base_source_contract.log
At exact candidate b53a21a7, all 13 candidate dimension, normalization, deep-stack indexing, and boundary tests passed. Raw output: reports/j-dd5fea64a4ad/raw/candidate_regression.log

Confirmed candidate dimensions, text fallback, valid deep-stack IDs, rejected substring false positives, and that unindexed MOSS merger names still return no layer ID. Raw output: reports/j-dd5fea64a4ad/raw/candidate_adversarial_contract.log

Independent regression failed as intended: selected MOSS visual.merger.linear_fc1/linear_fc2 modules were both skipped, with zero wrapped or registered modules. Raw output: reports/j-dd5fea64a4ad/raw/candidate_moss_registration_counterexample.log

Qwen-shaped BF16 rank-32 projection arithmetic executed on gfx950 and was compared with CPU FP32. This does not test registration or full model serving. Raw output: reports/j-dd5fea64a4ad/raw/gpu_linear_fc_reference.log

gpu_execution.evidence: AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950 ran the Qwen projection arithmetic fixture; no full Qwen3-VL or MOSS-VL model was run.

remaining_counterexamples: At candidate b53a21a7, LoRAManager.init_lora_modules skips selected MOSS-VL visual.merger.linear_fc1 and visual.merger.linear_fc2 modules because get_layer_id returns None for unindexed merger paths; no LoRA wrapper is installed.
remaining_limitations: Qwen3-VL-8B/EditScore and MOSS-VL model and adapter weights were unavailable, so full model loading, HTTP serving, and semantic multimodal output were not verified.
The available accelerator was one AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950 under ROCm 7.2, not the issue's NVIDIA H100/CUDA platform.
The GPU run validates Qwen projection arithmetic only and does not qualify MOSS-VL registration or architecture execution.
No native source changed in the candidate, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
